Dear Alexandra,

We are sorry for the misunderstanding and any inconvenience caused.

After reviewing our appointment records, we confirmed that your appointment was scheduled for the following day, not the day you visited our clinic.

It appears there was a misunderstanding regarding the appointment date, and we sincerely apologize if this information was not communicated clearly enough.

At BonoMedica Budva, we strive to provide professional, reliable, and attentive care to every patient, and we regret that your experience did not meet your expectations.

Kind regards,
BonoMedica Budva Team
